title: Go Tell Aunt Rhody
songSummary: Practices the five-finger home, steps and skips, counting three and four, and how lines end, while you and your child play an old tune together.

classes.title: Find your five-finger home
classes.goal: Hear the song and rest one finger on each of the five home keys.
classes.parentTip: Point to the two black keys, then help your child rest the thumb on C.
